#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized release binary at ./app. Uses only the Nim stdlib.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
nim c -d:release --opt:speed --hints:off --nimcache:.nimcache -o:app src/kvhttp.nim

# Package

version       = "0.1.0"
author        = "kvhttp authors"
description   = "In-memory HTTP/1.1 key-value server"
license       = "MIT"
srcDir        = "src"
bin           = @["kvhttp"]

# Dependencies

requires "nim >= 2.0.0"
